core_obligations: Choose a resolution (proof lines 1377-1390): the author resolves the sheaf injectively and identifies the derived global sections with the complex of global sections of the resolution, while the Cech complex is computed on the same complex.

Build the transformation (proof lines 1390-1405): the comparison map from the Cech complex to the resolution gives, by the acyclicity of the sheaves involved, a transformation from the Cech complex to the derived sections functor.
Read off the cohomology maps (proof lines 1405-1413): taking cohomology gives the displayed transformations on the Cech cohomology groups, which is the second assertion.
proof_roadmap: Resolve injectively and identify the derived sections with the resolution's sections.
Construct the comparison map from the Cech complex to the resolution.
Deduce the transformation and the maps on cohomology groups.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the comparison transformation from the Cech complex of a covering to the derived global sections functor, and the resulting maps on Cech cohomology groups (statement lines 1360-1375). The proof resolves the sheaf injectively and identifies the derived sections with the sections of the resolution (proof lines 1377-1390), constructs the comparison map and uses acyclicity to obtain the transformation (proof lines 1390-1405), and reads off the maps on cohomology (proof lines 1405-1413). The non-formal content is the identification of the derived functor with the resolution used to compare. The claim is H2: one construction from a chosen resolution.
